object.attr: derived: a document missing from discovery, or a rules file deleted, renamed or emptied, leaves the gate passing; these lines show both in the log (CF-C3, CF-C10, CF-C23). Deleting a whole document that nothing links to still passes: an accepted risk, since the deletion is the largest change in the diff.
object.description: mellon-check shall print for each document checked a line holding the document ID and the number of rules in the document's rules file, or 0 for a document without one.
